subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft / timeline reforecast - Acme Healthcare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-02-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (next steps)

Hi Tom and Sarah,

Thanks again for taking the time to run through the platform this morning - really appreciated the candid feedback. Below is a short recap and the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft I promised. Please let me know what I missed and any adjustments to owners/timelines.

Recap (brief):
- Use case: Clinical documentation summarization and secure PHI handling for outpatient clinics.
- Success metrics: 85% first-pass accuracy on document-level summaries; infra latency < 300ms median for the targeted routes.
- Concerns called out: SOC2 evidence + data residency for patient records.

Draft MAP (milestones / owners / dependencies / target dates):
1) Legal & Security review - Acme: Legal (Tom) / Redwood: Security (Neha) - dependency: SOC2 + security questionnaire completed - target: 2026-02-28
2) Private deployment planning (network & KMS) - Acme: IT (procurement@acmehealth.com) / Redwood: Solutions (Rishi) - dependency: infra scoping session - target: 2026-03-15
3) Pilot (2 clinics) - Acme: Clinical Lead (Sarah) / Redwood: Customer Success (Vivek) - dependency: contract signed + data onboarding plan - target: 2026-04-15
4) Production rollout (phased) - Acme: Ops / Redwood: Delivery - dependency: pilot success metrics - target: 2026-06-01

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (live MAP table) and Acme_security_questions.pdf (answers to initial sec questions). MAP is also in the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-ExampleMapLink

Next steps I propose:
- Tom: confirm Legal/Security reviewers and whether the SOC2 package we sent is sufficient for your audit team (reply by 2026-02-17)
- IT/Procurement: confirm preferred procurement path (PO vs SOW) and any vendor onboarding docs (please loop in procurement@acmehealth.com)
- Rishi & Neha: schedule infra scoping call with Acme IT - 1-hour slot next week

If everyone is aligned I will update the MAP spreadsheet and mark dependencies with owners.

Thanks - Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0199
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-02-17T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (next steps)

Marissa,

Appreciate the clear summary and the MAP. Quick update from our side - two items that affect timelines:
1) Our finance team has pushed back the Q2 vendor approvals cadence and procurement is now signing off on new vendors the week of 2026-04-01 (was earlier in March).
2) Our Security team needs an additional follow-up on data retention controls specific to clinical notes; they asked for a short tech deep-dive before signing off.

Given those, we need to push the pilot target to mid-May and expect the procurement/PO step to land in late-April. We still want to proceed - the use case is high priority - but the dates in the MAP need a reforecast.

I'll loop in procurement for timelines (they're cc'ed). Also, Sarah confirms she'll be the clinical lead; she'll help prioritize clinics for the pilot.

- Tom

I've updated the MAP to reflect your notes: pilot target moved to 2026-05-15, procurement milestone moved to 2026-04-25 (to reflect late-April PO window), and added a new Security deep-dive milestone (owner: Neha) with a target of 2026-03-05 so we can get the answers to your retention questions early.

Attached: Acme_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (MAP v1.1) - the change log is on the second tab. I also attached the security questionnaire answers we previously prepared; Neha will be available next Thursday for a 30-45min technical Q&A with your Security team.

- Tom / procurement: confirm the PO path and whether the April 25th milestone is realistic for your internal calendar
- Sarah: confirm pilot clinic list by 2026-03-01 so we can prepare the onboarding plan
- Neha: please confirm availability for the Sec deep-dive (I proposed 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-04 as options)

If I don't hear concerns I'll mark the MAP as v1.1 and push it to the shared Drive and HubSpot record.

Thanks - Marissa

Hi Tom and Sarah,

Thanks for the visibility on the procurement cadence. We've discussed internally and are aligned on the reprioritized dates. Per Marissa's v1.1 MAP:
- Security deep-dive (Neha) - target 2026-03-05 (we'll hold the 30-45min slot on 2026-03-05 at 10:00 AM PT unless you prefer a different time)
- Procurement / PO target - 2026-04-25 (Redwood will prepare a procurement packet and vendor onboarding checklist by 2026-03-20)
- Pilot start - 2026-05-15 (Vivek to own pilot ops and success criteria)

Tom - quick question on the PO: will Acme require a customer-specific SOW or will a standard order form suffice? If you can confirm by 2026-03-10 that will help Rishi and I scope the onboarding resources.

I'll update HubSpot and mark the MAP as v1.1 with the new target close of 2026-05-20 (reflects internal cadence + 4 weeks for pilot run).

Best,
Vivek
